answer:
Done — I made a Page for “Stocks I watch” that calculates portfolio value and profit from your shares, buy price, and current price.

Amber Pages can’t make network calls, so it can’t fetch live Yahoo Finance prices directly. I added editable “Current price” and “Currency” columns instead; update those in the Page and it recalculates profit instantly.

Deleting or replacing a page never loses data.
